task report(topic: string) -> bool
      raw = call web_search(topic)             ; line 6
      t1 = raw[0]                              ; line 7
      clean = call sanitize(t1)                ; line 7

      summary = call llm(t2)                   ; line 8
      t3 = call confirm("Send report?")        ; line 9

  L2:
      return false                             ; line 12
